subject.title: fix: allow bailian provider in resolveThinkingProfile

question: Should OpenClaw accept `bailian` as a supported custom-provider inference id for Qwen thinking compat, or should Bailian/Coding Plan reasoning stay only in Qwen-owned provider work?
rationale: Source inspection shows the custom-provider gap is real, but enabling a provider id from compat metadata changes upgrade behavior and sits next to broader Qwen/Coding Plan product ownership decisions.

options.title: Accept narrow custom-provider inference
options.body: Accept the generic agent-path change after removing the vLLM hook, adding focused tests, and posting changed-path Bailian proof.

options.title: Defer to Qwen provider work
options.body: Pause this PR and continue official Bailian/Coding Plan reasoning through the canonical Qwen provider issue and provider-owned PRs.

options.title: Require one consolidated fix
options.body: Ask for a single Qwen/Bailian PR that covers bundled catalog, custom-provider inference, docs, tests, and vendor proof together.

recommendation.title: Accept narrow custom-provider inference
recommendation.body: Accept the generic agent-path change after removing the vLLM hook, adding focused tests, and posting changed-path Bailian proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior issue review and related discussion route the Qwen/Bailian support-boundary decision through this maintainer history.
